title: Persona
description: Contract every persona config.yaml under personas/<org>/<team>/ is validated against. Tightened per phase (GCP -> AWS -> Azure); the GCP grant shape below mirrors the preconditions in root/gcp/validation.tf, so a file that passes this schema should also pass the plan. Identity is DERIVED from this file and never written in it: the Okta group is <ORG>-<TEAM>-<CLOUD>-<PERMISSION_SET.NAME> and the GCP custom role is the same, lowercased with underscores.

org.description: Owning org; must match the personas/<org>/ folder. No hyphens — this is one segment of the hyphen-delimited Okta group name.

team.description: Owning team; must match the personas/<org>/<team>/ folder. No hyphens — this is one segment of the hyphen-delimited Okta group name.

privileged.description: True for privileged personas (extra approval / JIT expected). METADATA ONLY — nothing in root/ reads this yet; it does not add any gate.

entitlement.description: The access, split by cloud. At least one cloud is required. Phase 1 implements gcp only.

access.description: Request behavior for this persona. METADATA ONLY — nothing in root/ reads this yet. Recording an approver here does NOT enforce approval.

self_service.description: Whether users can self-request this persona.

approval.description: Approvers for access requests (identities/groups, not empty).

cloudBlock.description: Per-cloud entitlement holding a list of grants.

grants.description: One grant = what (permission_set) + where (assign_by scope). Phase 1 reads grants[0] only.

grant.description: A permission set plus the scope it is assigned in.

assign_at.description: Resource-side scope. RESERVED for the Azure phase — not read today.

permissionSet.description: What the grant confers. The role sources are ADDITIVE — any combination, but at least one must be non-empty or the plan fails precondition [10].

name.description: The access identity. Derives the Okta group name <ORG>-<TEAM>-<CLOUD>-<NAME> and the cloud role ID, so changing it replaces live resources. Mixed case is allowed and lowercased when names are derived.

builtin_roles.description: GCP. Google predefined roles, bound only — nothing is created. A project- or org-level custom role belongs in shared_roles.

custom_role.description: GCP. Persona-specific custom role, created in every target project and then bound.

shared_roles.description: GCP. Existing SecArch-owned custom roles — bound, never created or modified. Must be fully qualified.

managed_policies.description: AWS. Provider-owned managed policies. RESERVED for the AWS phase — not read today.

shared_managed_policies.description: AWS. References to definitions in personas/_shared/ (must exist). RESERVED for the AWS phase — not read today.

inline_policy.description: AWS. Persona-specific least-privilege supplement. RESERVED for the AWS phase — not read today.

stage.description: GCP custom role launch stage. Defaults to GA when omitted.

permissions_file.description: Path to a JSON file holding a non-empty "permissions" array, relative to THIS persona folder (e.g. permission.json) so the persona stays portable. Wildcards are rejected — list every permission explicitly so an access review can read the grant.

scope.description: Where the grant applies. Keys depend on cloud: projects for GCP (phase 1); accounts/account_ou for AWS; management_groups/subscriptions/resource_groups for Azure. Prod and non-prod are separated by workspace, not by a key in this file.

projects.description: GCP. Every project the group is granted access in. The custom role is created once per project, since GCP custom roles are project-scoped.

items.description: A valid GCP project ID: 6-30 characters, lowercase letter first, letters/digits/hyphens, not ending in a hyphen.

accounts.description: AWS. RESERVED for the AWS phase — not read today.

account_ou.description: AWS. RESERVED for the AWS phase — not read today.

management_groups.description: Azure. RESERVED for the Azure phase — not read today.

subscriptions.description: Azure. RESERVED for the Azure phase — not read today.

resource_groups.description: Azure. RESERVED for the Azure phase — not read today.
